name: JD Vance
role: 50th Vice President of the United States (2025-)
summary: A national-conservative Republican who pairs restrictive immigration, tariffs and pro-natal social conservatism with antitrust enforcement, support for unions on some issues, and skepticism of foreign aid and intervention.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Opposes general tax increases but proposed raising the university endowment tax from 1.4% to 35% and ending tax-free treatment of large mergers.

unions-good.rationale: Backed the striking UAW workers in 2023, criticizes right-to-work laws and favors workers' councils and sectoral bargaining, while opposing the PRO Act (AFL-CIO score 0%).

regulate-corporations.rationale: Supports antitrust enforcement, has called for breaking up Google, and said Biden's FTC chair Lina Khan was 'doing a pretty good job.'

cut-welfare.rationale: Opposes cuts to Social Security and Medicare and backed raising the child tax credit to $5,000 per child (2024).

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: At Munich: 'we may disagree with your views, but we will fight to defend your right to offer it in the public square'; criticized Europe's 'digital censorship.'

limit-guns.rationale: Calls himself 'a big pro-Second Amendment guy'; in a 2022 candidate survey backed abolishing the ATF and repealing the National Firearms Act, and opposed universal background checks and red-flag laws.

empower-police-military.rationale: Blamed rising crime on policies that make police 'terrified of doing their job' (2022).

traditional-family.rationale: Describes himself as a natalist, praised Hungary's pro-natal policies and has said 'marriage is between one man and one woman.'

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Opposed the Respect for Marriage Act (2022) and said marriage is between one man and one woman, while calling the issue 'not alive right now.'

abortion-legal.rationale: Supported overturning Roe v. Wade and said in 2022 he 'would like abortion to be illegal nationally,' later backing exceptions for rape, incest and the mother's life and saying states should decide.

more-religion-public.rationale: Cites Catholic social teaching as an influence and said religious liberty in Britain is 'in the crosshairs.'

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Proposed making gender-affirming surgery for minors a federal felony (2023) and introduced the Passport Sanity Act.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Introduced a bill to make English the official language (2023) and told Europe it needs a clear sense of 'what exactly it is that you're defending yourselves for.'

gradual-change.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposes 'mass immigration' and amnesty: 'No voter on this continent went to the ballot box to open the floodgates to millions of unvetted immigrants.'

empower-international-orgs.rationale: No recorded position found in the sources consulted.

free-trade.rationale: Supports tariffs and reshoring manufacturing; criticized the 'globalist economy' for leaving the U.S. borrowing from Chinese manufacturers (2025).

nation-first.rationale: Opposed further military aid to Ukraine and called Europe 'the permanent security vassal of the United States', urging it 'to step up in a big way to provide for its own defense.'

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Called his support for the 2003 Iraq War a 'mistake,' though he backed the 2025 strikes on Iranian nuclear sites.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Has questioned whether climate change is man-made and advocates more domestic fossil-fuel production.
